This is a senior-level software engineering role (5+ years) at Kreative Technologies, working remotely on backend systems and services — architecture design, production code, performance, scalability, and security, plus technical design and code reviews. The core stack is a general-purpose backend language such as Java, C#, or Python, with APIs, relational databases, and software design patterns. Cloud platforms (AWS or Azure), containers, and microservices feature as well, alongside Git and CI/CD pipelines for automated testing and delivery.
